title: Coherent Cech module direct-image model
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site in a fixed universe [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] [def-weil-size-convention], let $R$ be a ring sheaf and write $\operatorname{Mod}(R)$ for its module-sheaf category [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For a sheaf of sets $A$, use the canonical element-site restriction $j_A^*$ with localized ring $R_A$ [def-pur-localized-ringed-site] [def-sfb-element-site-localization]. A coherent Cech image model consists of additive right adjoints $j_{A*}$ with $j_A^*\dashv j_{A*}$, a contravariant functor $A\mapsto E_A$ to endofunctors of $\operatorname{Mod}(R)$, and identifications $E_A\cong j_A^*\,;\,j_{A*}$ (apply restriction, then direct image). For every $b:B\to A$, its map $E_A(M)\to E_B(M)$ is characterized by adjunction: after transposition through $j_B^*\dashv j_{B*}$ it is restriction along $b$ of the counit transpose of $E_A(M)\cong j_{A*}j_A^*M$. Include continuity of the element-site maps, so these restrictions are the canonical sectionwise ones. Include augmentations $M\to E_A(M)$ whose adjoint transposes are identities and which commute with all $b$; these are the localization units. For a sheaf $V$, its canonical Cech nerve is that of $V\to1$. The model includes additivity of the alternating coface complex functor $M\mapsto C^\bullet(V,M)$ formed from $E_{V^{n+1}}(M)$. For an additive $G:\operatorname{Mod}(R)\to\mathcal B$ to an abelian category and a nonnegative cochain complex $I$, define the coherent bicomplex $B^{n,q}=G(C^n(V,I^q))$, its functorial first-quadrant total [def-sp-double-complex-total], and its extension by zero to integer degrees. Its differential is $d_{\mathrm{Cech}}+(-1)^n d_I$, so each degree has only finitely many summands. A map $W\to V$ induces the actual contravariant nerve-restriction map on these complexes and totals. A chain map $b:G(I)\to\operatorname{Tot}B$ is an augmentation precisely when its degree-$q$ component is $G(I^q\to E_V(I^q))$ followed by the $(0,q)$ summand inclusion.
